articles.title: Old teammate Kurt Suzuki has only positive words for Craig Breslow and Andrew Bailey, and other Red Sox thoughts
articles.description: The three all played together in Oakland from 2009-2011.

articles.title: How much does a team’s September performance equate to winning in the playoffs?
articles.description: The Red Sox have gone 7-5 this month, balancing keeping players healthy with being competitive. Is there any correlation between now and the postseason?

articles.title: Tanner Houck, closing in on return to big leagues, could be a playoff option for Red Sox
articles.description: Houck has pitched as both a starter and reliever throughout his Red Sox career.

articles.title: ‘He’s an electric human being’: Red Sox clinch winning record on Payton Tolle’s historic day
articles.description: Tolle's achievement was rarer in Sox lore than cycles (23), no-hitters (18), and World Series championships (nine).

articles.title: Former Red Sox star Rafael Devers placed on 60-day IL to end season, and he may have surgery
articles.description: Devers leads the Giants with 37 home runs and 98 RBIs this season.

articles.title: Payton Tolle completes first Red Sox immaculate inning since 2021 to open start against Royals
articles.description: Tolle finished the eighth immaculate inning in Red Sox history by striking out Nick Loftin, Bobby Witt Jr., and Jac Caglianone on nine pitches.

articles.title: Red Sox vs. Royals in a rain delay, first pitch will be at 4:55 p.m.
articles.description: Payton Tolle toes the rubber as the Red Sox look to win the series against the Royals.

articles.title: Willson Contreras returns to Red Sox as Anthony Seigler lands on IL
articles.description: Contreras missed a dozen games because of a left hamstring strain.

articles.title: Another strong start from Ranger Suarez helps Red Sox beat Royals, end three-game skid
articles.description: Suarez held Kansas City to one run and five hits in seven innings, while striking out eight and walking none.

articles.title: Johan Oviedo returns to Red Sox to join Garrett Crochet and Tanner Houck in an attempt to pitch this season
articles.description: Oviedo has missed more than five months because of a strained right flexor/elbow and has been based in Fort Myers, Fla., for much of that time.

articles.title: By any metric, Payton Tolle’s rookie season in the Red Sox rotation has been ‘amazing’
articles.description: The 23-year-old lefthander, who will start Sunday against the Royals, is having the best first season in the Red Sox rotation since World War II.

articles.title: Red Sox-Royals series finale Sunday pushed back to 3:05 p.m. because of forecast for rain
articles.description: The change was made because of "a forecast for an extended period of rain throughout the morning and early afternoon.”

articles.title: Game 149: Royals at Red Sox lineups and notes
articles.description: Ranger Suarez gets the ball for the Red Sox, who take on Randy Dobnak and the Royals.

articles.title: Plenty of stories to be told of Joe Morgan, who lived a baseball life to the fullest right to the end
articles.description: Tales about Morgan, signed by the Boston Braves in 1952 and in the game until 1991 when his Sox managerial run ended, will be aplenty at his wake in Walpole Thursday.

articles.title: Junior Caminero’s walk-off home run helps Rays become first team to clinch playoff berth this season
articles.description: Caminero's 417-foot shot to left-center off Bryan Abreu was his 40th of the season and sparked a joyous celebration at the plate.

articles.title: Sonny Gray battles, but gets battered by sub-.500 Royals as Red Sox drop a third straight to a laggard
articles.description: The Red Sox lost their third straight game as the Royals put nine balls in play against the starter at 100 m.p.h. or harder.
